To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@pioneerhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-15 09:15 PST
Subject: Renewal planning and MAP request

Hi Jonas,

Hope you're well. We're starting to formalize the renewal discussion for Pioneer Health's pilot seats (renewal due end of month) and we'd like a clear mutual action plan that covers:
- Target close date (we're aiming for Nov 30)
- Milestones for procurement, security review, and deployment for two additional clinical teams
- Pricing impact for the "Clinical Add-on" seat pack and the telemetry retention upgrade

Can you share a draft MAP and an evaluation plan we can use with procurement and security? Attaching last week's usage report for context.

Thanks,
Sophie

Head of Data Science, Pioneer Health

Hi Sophie — thanks for the context and the usage file.

I've drafted a focused MAP and an evaluation checklist that align to the timelines you mentioned. High level:
- Milestone 1 (Nov 18): Security questionnaire returned / data flow diagram confirmed (owner: Pioneer Security)
- Milestone 2 (Nov 22): Pilot expansion smoke test with two clinical teams (owner: Pioneer Data Ops)
- Milestone 3 (Nov 25): Procurement sign-off and DocuSign envelope prepared
- Target close: Nov 30 (DocuSign complete + provisioning)

I've attached the draft (Pioneer_MAP_v1.2) — Marissa, can you validate the rollout steps and suggest any gating metrics? Grace, can you confirm estimated billing delta for the add-on seat pack and telemetry retention change?

Next steps: I will update the MAP with your inputs and upload v1.3 with a DocuSign link by Monday.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-17 14:30 PST
Subject: Re: Renewal planning and MAP request

Quick notes from CS side —
- Suggested gating metric: 7-day active user retention on the new teams > 65% before provisioning full add-on. We'll run a small canary with 10 users per team.
- Support ramp: we recommend a one-week onboarding window with two 30-min enablement sessions for team leads. Owner: Marissa Cole (CS).
- Risk: telemetry retention increase will require a short update to the ingestion pipeline; estimate 48 hours work for infra ops.

I'll add these to the MAP and flag the canary dates (Nov 20–22).

Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@pioneerhealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@pioneerhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-19 08:45 PST
Subject: Re: Renewal planning and MAP request

Thanks — that level of detail is helpful. A couple of asks from procurement:
1) Can you provide the delta for the Clinical Add-on seat pack (20 seats) vs our current pilot pricing? We need a line-item.
2) Can you confirm whether increasing telemetry retention to 90 days affects our SLA or egress limits?
3) If we commit to the Nov 30 close, procurement will prioritize signatures — otherwise they'll push to December.

Can Marissa and Grace weigh in on 1 & 2 so we can get internal approvals this week?

Sophie

Action items (owners & target dates):
- Finalize security questionnaire answers (Sophie / Pioneer Security) — Nov 22 — status: in progress
- Run canary with 10 users/team and validate retention >65% (Marissa Cole) — Nov 20–22 — status: complete, pass
- Confirm billing delta for 20-seat Clinical Add-on: +$3,600/mo (Grace O'Connor) — Nov 22 — status: confirmed
- Prepare procurement packet & DocuSign (Jonas Weber) — Nov 24 — status: draft prepared
- Provision telemetry retention increase (Infra Ops coordination) — Nov 25 — status: depends on infra window

Notes:
- Pricing detail attached (line-item in the MAP v1.3). Telemetry retention to 90 days has a small storage cost; it does not change the SLA but may increase monthly egress/storage by ~2%.
- I created the DocuSign envelope and will send as soon as procurement confirms the signers. HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7239

Attachments: Pioneer_MAP_v1.3.xlsx, usage-dashboard-weekly.png, Pioneer_DocuSign_Instructions.txt

Next meeting: quick 15-min sync Thursday Nov 25 at 10:00 PT to confirm go/no-go for provisioning. If we get signatures by Nov 24, we can keep the Nov 30 target close.

Thanks all —
